directive.quote: preserve existing request renderer and executor while moving them to generic owner

preserve: buildInvocation: render an invocation from its template and request data
encodeBody: preserve JSON, form, and byte body encodings
HTTP execution: validate public addresses and redirects, handle credentials and held reply values, and report service errors
allowed_deltas: Move the renderer and executor into the generic HTTP client and re-export the existing caller API from its keeper package.
Use the current canonical public-address owner and the existing Node connection-time DNS guarded transport, without copying address rules.
Format credential-name UTF-8 bytes as hexadecimal with the equivalent pure formatter, avoiding an added runtime dependency.
Bound fetched template input with the canonical streaming response reader; cancel oversized or unreadable input.
Mask declared held reply values in every reply branch, including duplicate appearances, reports and service errors; keep storage and transport errors opaque.
Only an initial refusal declares not_sent; a redirect refusal after dispatch, transport failure or unread reply does not imply safe automatic replay. No request retry is added.
banned_substitutions: a different template grammar or request rendering model
a replacement request executor that omits address, redirect, credential, or held-value checks
a second HTTP invocation implementation in the keeper package
